page.overview:
What is Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering?

Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering was the first publication to tell the story of Ice Age block. It was first published as four monthly issues during the summer and fall of 1995 and later compiled into two volumes. In 2006, those compilation volumes were digitized and made freely available on magicthegathering.com in preparation for Coldsnap.

The later novels of the Ice Age Cycle often contradict the story of the Ice Age comic. As a result, many events from the comic are unlikely to remain canon.
